description: Keep your agents on OpenVibe.Actor. A contact (plan §12 A-1; actor.agent@1, actor.agent-list@1): GET/POST /api/v1/agents, GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/agents/:id and PUT /api/v1/agents/:id/level (actor.level-change@1), with Vibe created on the first read and never deletable and four presets at GET /api/v1/agents/presets to copy. A personal run (standing instructions, mode, a budget per run, a daily run cap and a schedule): create, read, change and delete one, read, add, edit and delete what it remembers, or forget everything, and read what it suggested adding to its instructions and apply, dismiss or undo a suggestion. A person's agents are theirs alone; another person's agent is 404.
